highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.155.0 previews Skia m155 and the HarfBuzz 14.4 shaping update.
highlights_body: The line retires RAW/DNG decoding and includes Ganesh failed-flush cache cleanup plus a fontconfig candidate-order correction.

breaking.title: Use an external decoder for RAW and DNG images
breaking.body: Built-in RAW/DNG decoding and PIEX extraction of embedded JPEG previews are disabled; no replacement reader is included. Decode these files externally before passing pixels to SkiaSharp. SKEncodedImageFormat.Dng remains for compatibility, but does not indicate codec support. Standalone JPEG decoding is unchanged.

breaking.title: Review cross-direction text layout after the HarfBuzz update
breaking.body: HarfBuzz 14.4 intentionally changes cross-direction mark positioning for DirectWrite and Core Text compatibility. Review text layouts and rendering baselines that depend on the previous shaping output before upgrading.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to m155 while preserving existing rotation-scale text-run bounds behavior and the managed binding surface.

Updates native HarfBuzz from 14.2.1 to 14.4.0, including glyph-position saturation and malformed-font crash and hang fixes. Adds OpenTypeBitsTag and OpenTypeNumberTag enums; raw fetch functions remain internal without new Face wrappers.

bullets.lead: Failed flushes discard unusable cached textures
bullets.detail: Ganesh drops uniquely held thread-safe cache entries after a failed flush, preventing later draws from reusing entries for textures that were never initialized. Entries still held elsewhere are not removed.
Tests family acceptability only on the first valid sorted candidate instead of scanning onward to a lower-ranked metric-compatible substitute, allowing the caller to try the next requested family.

preview_summaries.v4.155.0-preview.1.26471.14: Preview 1 opened the line with Skia m155 while preserving the existing managed binding surface and explicit rotation-scale text bounds.
preview_summaries.v4.155.0-preview.2.26479.13: Preview 2 updated native HarfBuzz to 14.4.0 and added the supported OpenType tag enums. It also retired RAW/DNG decoding and embedded JPEG-preview extraction.
preview_summaries.v4.155.0-rc.1.26512.8: Release Candidate 1 added Ganesh failed-flush cache cleanup and corrected fontconfig first-candidate matching.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates native HarfBuzz to 14.4.0 with cross-direction mark-positioning changes, glyph-position saturation, malformed-font fixes, and shaping/subsetting performance work. Adds OpenTypeBitsTag and OpenTypeNumberTag enums while keeping raw fetch functions internal.

v4.155.0-preview.1.26471.14.headline: Preview 1 opened the Skia m155 line without changing the managed API surface.

v4.155.0-preview.2.26479.13.headline: Preview 2 updated HarfBuzz to 14.4.0 and removed built-in RAW/DNG decoding and embedded RAW-preview extraction.

v4.155.0-rc.1.26512.8.headline: The release candidate corrected Ganesh cache cleanup after failed flushes and Linux fontconfig first-candidate matching.
